key_terms.ظَنَّ: to think, to assume, to suppose
key_terms.يَحُورَ: to return, to be brought back (for reckoning)

ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers assume about their return to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific claim of the disbelievers that death was an absolute end, reflecting their arrogance in assuming they would not be 'brought back' (yuhoor) for reckoning. This highlights the theological contrast between their worldly complacency and the inevitable return to the Creator, a core tenet of resurrection (Ma'ad) emphasized by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai.
